# Cooverly

> Cooverly is a Venture Development Partner. We help entrepreneurs, operating companies, private groups and family holdings validate, build and launch new digital businesses, products and corporate spin-offs.

We work remotely in English, Spanish and Italian with clients internationally, including founders and companies in the United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Cayman Islands, Switzerland, Singapore, Luxembourg, Monaco, the United States, the United Kingdom and Europe. Working with clients in these places does not mean Cooverly has offices there.

## How we work
- Phase 01 Validate: customer and problem definition, research and interviews, value proposition, pricing hypotheses, revenue and cost model. Output: an evidence brief and a recommendation to proceed, change or stop.
- Phase 02 Build & Launch: requirements, UX/UI, agreed development, sales materials, tracking and pilot launch.
- Phase 03 Operate & Grow: product priorities, commercial experiments, metrics, budget control, quarterly planning.

Focus: digital initiatives (software, platforms, new services, new business lines). No prices are published; scope and budget are agreed per project. No guaranteed financial results.
